div.head: VIII Atr 34
div.ab: And bete man ægðer ge him gé þam cynge, swa swa hit gebirige, be þam þe séo dæd sy, oððe he ða dæde wrece swiðe deope.
And bete man ægðer ge him ge þam cynge, swa swa hit gebirige, be þam þe séo dæd sy, oððe he ða dæde wrece swiðe deope.
And bete man ægðer ge him ge þam cynge, swa swa hit gebirige, be þam þe seo dæd sy, oððe he ða dæde wrece swiðe deope.
Und jener [Verletzer] büsse sowohl ihm als dem König, wie es sich gebührt, je nachdem die That ist, oder der [König] bestrafe die That sehr hoch.
And let that [offender] pay compensation both to him and to the king, as is fitting, according to what the deed is, or let the [king] avenge the deed very severely.
And compensation according to the nature of the deed shall be paid both to him and to the king, as is fitting, or he (the king) shall avenge the deed to the uttermost.
And compensation is to be paid both to him and to the king, as is fitting, in proportion to the deed, or he is to avenge the deed very severely.
And as is right, compensation suitable to the severity of the crime is to be paid both to him and the king, or the king will punish that crime most severely.
